scripts.dev: pnpm run copy:bootstrap-js && pnpm exec tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:css && pnpm run copy:bootstrap-js && pnpm exec tsc
scripts.build:css: pnpm run build:tailwind && pnpm run build:bootstrap
scripts.build:bootstrap: pnpm exec sass --load-path=node_modules src/static/css/bootstrap.custom.scss src/static/css/bootstrap.output.css --style compressed
scripts.watch:css: pnpm run watch:tailwind & pnpm run watch:bootstrap
scripts.watch:bootstrap: pnpm exec sass --load-path=node_modules src/static/css/bootstrap.custom.scss src/static/css/bootstrap.output.css --watch --style compressed
